excluded: delayed ACK, no-flight persist, congestion/fast recovery
timestamps and RTT cache across connections
independent data/close implementation evidence and unbounded protocol/refinement proof

RTT-ALG.interpretation: Exact rational SRTT/RTTVAR; update variance from old SRTT before smoothing SRTT with alpha=1/8 beta=1/4. Round RTO upward to integer ms, G=1ms, minimum 1000ms and optional maximum 60000ms.

RTT-KARN.interpretation: One outstanding sample anchored to an original segment end. Mark it ambiguous only when retransmitted sequence space overlaps its unacknowledged interval; never sample ambiguous ACKs. A fresh transmission may replace an ambiguous sample.

RTT-TIMER.interpretation: Start/preserve/restart/cancel one timer for byte and SYN/FIN flight. Recompute before a new ACK restart; backoff by two up to 60s. Keep inherited post-SYN-timeout lower-bound configuration until a valid sample arrives.

RTT-SCOPE.interpretation: Single connection with exact rational estimator and 1ms virtual clock. Samples include SYN, new data and FIN; partial ACK cannot complete the sample before its end. Existing finite buffers/sequence assumptions remain. This does not implement congestion or all recovery.
